decisions.decision: Store raw provider whale-exchange inflow/outflow/netflow unchanged and maintain a separate incident-adjusted sensitivity series. Exclude only individually verified incident transactions from the derived sensitivity, record exact transaction IDs, and never relabel the result as full-market netflow.
decisions.reason: Four Binance theft transfers sum to 224.806376M XRP and match the provider's rounded 224.81M Binance outflow; removing them changes the displayed tracked-flow net from -107.28M to approximately +117.5M.

decisions.decision: Relationship graph must distinguish transaction, provider label, destination tag, counterparty interaction, probable service role, and confirmed beneficial ownership. A multi-hop transaction route cannot be promoted to ownership/control without independent evidence.
decisions.reason: rJqi is provider-labelled Ripple; raRVLN and r39TAw are unlabeled. The route and RLUSD activity are important but do not identify the beneficial owner or trade purpose.

decisions.decision: Represent OCC application status, charter effectiveness, pre-opening conditions, operational launch, permitted activities, custody balances, and asset-specific collateralization as separate fields.
decisions.reason: Ripple and Circle CAS filings show effective dates; Coinbase CD1370 is preliminary conditional. None alone proves live XRP collateral utilization.

decisions.decision: Do not convert Ripple product-enabled transaction volume, Ripple Payments lifetime volume, annualized revenue run rate, or institutional counts into XRP demand or actual capital features without token-level settlement attribution.
decisions.reason: Company metrics aggregate products and acquisitions; XRP-specific settlement share is not disclosed.

decisions.decision: Maintain separate entities for SBIC West Japan, Tokyo SBIC East Japan, Nagoya SBIC, SBI Holdings/SBI Ripple Asia, and the academic Social Bias Inference Corpus.
decisions.reason: Official West Japan profile identifies regional sister companies and the ChatGPT seminar; the acronym also has an academic dataset meaning.

decisions.decision: All new whale-flow, wallet-route, RLUSD, macro and charter observations remain candidate/context-only; none is admitted to the XRP predictive feature store until point-in-time history, coverage, source independence and out-of-sample incremental value are validated.
decisions.reason: Provider scope, entity ownership and causal relevance remain unresolved; forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.
